flags.message: context.json freezes distribution_count=2 and band=elevated, but the docket shows the second distribution (Jul 8 2026, for the 9/28/2026 conference) followed a Response Requested entry (Mar 23 2026) that pulled the petition off its first conference (3/27/2026) before it was considered. The petition has not yet been relisted in the conference-carryover sense; the band was used as instructed, but readers of elevated-band skill should know this cell's count reflects a CFR redistribution rather than a relist.
